must: Use only public exports from @content-ventures/design-system/v3 and /icons for visual UI
Search the Design System before composing product components; add missing pieces to the DS with a specimen and a test
Preserve structural component spacing and responsive behavior
Use DS Tooltip for every hint; style in-document markers through Prose data-* hooks and DS proseWidgets
Write UI copy in Brazilian Portuguese; buttons start with a verb
avoid: Local visual primitives, tokens, fonts, icons, themes or substitute UI libraries
Local CSS modules, class names, inline styles, lowercase markup, DOM creation or editor node views
Adjacent open Section components inside PageStack
Decorative side borders or per-paragraph boxes
Filler copy: extra eyebrows, subtitles, hints or notices
Hover handlers that scroll the transcript

decisions: The user requested a visible local test-profile selector at the bottom-left sidebar account area, with Editor, Aprovador and Admin. Reuse the public DS Select and preserve keyboard focus while switching. Keep the account unchanged, retain unsaved form state, persist selected permissions across requests/reloads/local tabs, and expose the same choices in immersive production actions. Local Aprovador covers article and carousel review; cloud accounts never expose this capability.

New production confirms Material and Pauta, then opens the existing article editor with one queued generation. Planning and evidence selection run automatically in the saved pipeline; show animated preparation inside the editor until the live preview arrives. Keep toolbar, stop/retry, source attribution and reload continuity. Old structure URLs redirect to the editor; a queue refusal preserves the saved production there.

Material preparation opens a responsive Design System progress dialog for pasted text, files and imported links. Keep typing uninterrupted, allow the dialog to close and reopen without stopping processing, and distinguish reading/uploading, audio transcription and metadata analysis. Display upload percentages only from confirmed transferred bytes; processing remains indeterminate. Preserve source input on failures, offer the appropriate retry, and briefly confirm readiness before returning to the material form.

Polish the approved six Seafood carousel variations as premium B2B editorial creatives: a consistent 84px safe margin, opt-in balanced/optically fitted headlines with explicit minimum font sizes, intentional photo crops, quieter folio/signature and typographic quotation marks. Increase library thumbnail sharpness and desktop comparison size; allow each page to open in a readable DS Dialog with previous/next and a return action. Preserve all model IDs, slot contracts, stored copy, source references and existing exports; keep legacy render defaults unchanged. Do not add decorative charts, statistics, invented quotes or a parallel app design system.

The user approved Seafood Brasil-inspired photo-led navy/blue/cyan carousel directions. Offer six editable variations in Notícia, Explica and Podcast through the existing DS library, creation selector and switch drawer. Keep legacy IDs/defaults and article text; show fit warnings. Demo image/copy are explicitly illustrative and never substituted into real outputs. Preserve studio chrome, use a typeset brand label until the official logo asset arrives, and never invent statistics, podcast quotes or Marketing approval.
The product shell uses the complete DS navigation pattern
The visible menu contains only routes available to the user in the current release; Logs shows only to admins
Studios use the full width with one line of chrome above the text
Every production stage shares one compact header line with the Stepper
Status colours are reserved for state; meters and sparklines are neutral by default
AI output carries the Simulação local label while the product runs on the local simulation
Reporter consumes DS 0.2.0 from the editorial-studio branch until the version is tagged and pinned

Improve only the overview on release-one-experience: the approved photographic writer direction uses the real next action and the original personal/team queues; preserve all R1 screens, routes and workflow state

The user selected an editorial, visual overview with stories in focus: real article headlines and openings, existing article images, a prominent story to continue and a delivery-stage story to read; keep the original priorities and stage filters, with recent activity collapsible and no new workflow state

Story previews use compact equally sized cards with short headlines and openings truncated by DS ListItem ellipses, no internal scroll areas and aligned metadata/actions; the separately requested Escrever do zero entry opens an empty article in the existing studio alongside transcript creation

The user selected Pixabay for free commercial article and banner photography without obligatory published credits. Use horizontal originals of at least 2400 × 1350 pixels, seafood searches, optional editorial curation and uncropped previews. Identify reduced API previews honestly and require original-download access before importing; never upscale. Retain author, source and licence internally, show provider identification in the library, preserve legacy assets/licences and the approved Design System. Resolution and editorial awards do not guarantee relevance or aesthetic quality.
